questions.prompt: Which of these are noble gases?
questions.fact: Noble gases have full outer electron shells, which is why they barely react. Helium was found in the Sun's light before it was found on Earth.

questions.prompt: Which of these animals are mammals?
questions.fact: The platypus lays eggs and still feeds its young on milk, which is the rule that makes it a mammal.

questions.prompt: How fast does light travel, in kilometres per second?
questions.fact: 299,792 km every second. The sunlight on your face left the Sun about eight minutes ago.

questions.prompt: How many bones are in an adult human body?
questions.fact: 206. A baby is born with around 270, and many of them fuse together as the skeleton grows.

questions.prompt: Which planet has the most known moons?
questions.hint: The ringed one pulled ahead in 2023.
questions.fact: Saturn overtook Jupiter in 2023 and now has well over a hundred confirmed moons, most of them tiny.

questions.prompt: What is the hardest naturally occurring substance?
questions.hint: It is pure carbon, and so is one of the wrong answers.
questions.fact: Diamond and graphite are both pure carbon. The only difference is how the atoms are bonded together.
